title: Research dataset recipes
summary: Searchable starting points for common research requests. Presets select from existing products and documented joins; they do not create a second product hierarchy or claim that missing methods have been resolved.

presets.title: Baseline research table
presets.description: A wide condition-by-visit-by-life-stage table that brings together current community climate affinity, condition disturbance, and plot structure. This is the closest current reproducible answer to the requested giant baseline file without replacing the canonical products.
cautions: Plot structure values repeat across condition and life-stage rows and must not be summed.
Mortality is not included here because the current mortality product is interval-grain, not visit-grain.
Slope and aspect are not yet extracted; elevation is available.
Native/non-native agent status is not yet classified.
missing_capabilities: A visit/interval panel that explicitly aligns mortality with the ending visit
Reviewed native/non-native insect and pathogen classification

presets.title: Condition CWM with disturbance context
presets.description: Community-weighted temperature, precipitation, and CWD affinity at every condition visit and life stage, with condition-specific disturbance flags.
cautions: Disturbance flags repeat across life stages.
This is visit-level CWM context; it is not yet a panel containing interval mortality.
presets.missing_capabilities: Explicit alignment of interval mortality to the ending visit

presets.title: Condition-matched understory records
presets.description: Join mapped condition metadata to understory structure observations as a starting point for inspecting repeat support and defining change metrics.
cautions: This expands one condition to multiple subplot, growth-habit, and canopy-layer records.
It exposes existing observations only; comparable change metrics and protocol rules remain a methods decision.

presets.title: Plot structure and diversity visits
presets.description: Attach tree and seedling density, richness, and diversity summaries to the official remeasurement components used to order plot visits through time.
cautions: Values are visit summaries; interval deltas and annualized rates are not calculated by this recipe.
The remeasurement component product is reproducible but still marked not reviewed.
presets.missing_capabilities: Reviewed interval change and annualized change fields

presets.title: Exact FIA damage-agent names
presets.description: Live-tree damage observations with official/common agent labels and any available scientific name retained from the FIA lookup.
cautions: Damage on a living tree is not the same observation as a condition disturbance or a cause of death.
The lookup does not currently include a reviewed native/non-native classification.

presets.title: Life-stage CWM change with interval mortality
presets.description: Stable-condition change in climate affinity by life stage, with cumulative interval mortality predictors attached at the matching interval.
cautions: Mortality values repeat across life-stage rows and must not be summed across layers.
These analysis products remain marked not reviewed in the product registry.

presets.title: Condition-history mortality with site CWD
presets.description: One row per complete stable-condition history, combining cumulative agent mortality with cumulative site climatic water deficit.
cautions: Keep the CWD completeness flag or explicitly filter it before modeling.
This is first-to-last history grain, not a visit-level panel.
